title: B5 fix round: README benchmark paragraph describes the Scrapling fetch, not a manual snapshot; add bench fetch and the cap note
spec:
Why: T-0020 (3b5384f) wrote the README from its original spec text, which predates the user decision of 2026-09-17 to fetch with Scrapling. The "## Executors and routing" section currently says the snapshot is "manual by design" and that `bench set` is "the normal path", and its CLI line omits `bench fetch`. Correct it; this worktree branches from task/T-0020.

What (1 file: README.md):
1. Replace the benchmark sentences in "## Executors and routing" with: cold-start prior comes from `orchestrator bench fetch`, which pulls https://artificialanalysis.ai/models with Scrapling's plain HTTP Fetcher as an identified client (User-Agent `orchestrator-bench/1`, no TLS impersonation, no stealth headers), at most once per 20 h unless `--force`, parses the page's React Server Component chunks, matches display names (effort suffixes tolerated, the max variant preferred) to our model ids, and writes `.orchestrator/bench.json` with provenance (`fetched_at`, `http_status`, `request`); a non-200 or empty result never overwrites the file; page content is untrusted data. The site's Terms of Use restrict automated access; the user decided on 2026-09-17 to proceed under these limits. `bench set <model_id> --by <name> key=value` remains for manual overrides (marked `manual: true`).
2. CLI line: add `orchestrator bench fetch [--force] [--by NAME]`.
3. "Verify on your machine" list: change the `window_cap_tokens` bullet to say it was raised from 2M to 10M on 2026-09-17 after 2M was reached in 2.2 h with zero real rate limits; real limits still cool an account via the reset-hint parser.
Keep the section at ≤28 lines. No other files. Run `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py` (docs only; must stay green). Commit: "docs: benchmark input is the identified Scrapling fetch; bench fetch in CLI list; window cap note" with a revert-path body.
acceptance: README no longer contains 'manual by design' or 'hand-entering numbers is the normal path'
README mentions bench fetch, orchestrator-bench User-Agent, no impersonation, 20 h, untrusted data, and the 2026-09-17 decision

result.summary:
Committed on `task/T-0041` (3dc3786), working tree clean.

**Summary:** Updated the "Executors and routing" section in README.md to reflect the 2026-09-17 decision to fetch benchmark data via Scrapling instead of manual entry. Removed "manual by design" / "hand-entering numbers is the normal path", added detail on `orchestrator bench fetch` (identified User-Agent, no impersonation, 20h cache, RSC-chunk parsing, provenance fields, untrusted-page-content note), added `bench fetch` to the CLI line, kept `bench set` for manual overrides, and updated the `window_cap_tokens` bullet to note the 2M→10M raise on 2026-09-17.

**Files changed:** README.md only (13 insertions, 5 deletions).

**Test output:** `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py` — Ran 63 tests, OK (no failures). Section stays at 25 lines (≤28 limit).

Nothing left — task complete.
